factProposals.value: Response documents are stored by category with version, size, media type and SHA-256; replacements keep the old version as superseded.
Only compliance officers, procurement officers, the TxDOT contract manager and system administrators may upload or open response documents; refusals are logged.

decisions.statement: An upload counts only after the stored file is read back and matches its hash.
decisions.rationale: A failed store is caught at upload, not when someone needs the document.

decisions.statement: Each opening is timed and the time is logged with it.
decisions.rationale: The acceptance sets a 2 second retrieval target.

limitations.statement: Files are kept in the browser (IndexedDB) for the demo, up to 10 MB each; a shared document store replaces it for real use.
